title: Amendments as versioned deltas after validation

invariants.statement: WHEN a clause changes after its contract is VALIDATED, THE SYSTEM SHALL record the change as a versioned delta (ADDED, MODIFIED, REMOVED) against clause IDs, never as a silent edit.
invariants.property: forall changes ch: applied(ch) => kind(ch) in {ADDED, MODIFIED, REMOVED}

check.notes: delta format: OpenSpec-style against stable aliases
